events.description: Ross Geller asks how Phoebe Buffay's date went.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe's boyfriend walked Phoebe Buffay to the subway.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe's boyfriend said that Phoebe Buffay and Phoebe's boyfriend should go out again.
Rachel Green asks whether Phoebe's boyfriend saying that Phoebe Buffay and Phoebe's boyfriend should go out again is good.
Monica Geller says that the phrase 'We should do this again' means that Phoebe Buffay will never see Phoebe's boyfriend naked.
Joey Tribbiani says that using euphemistic dating phrases like 'We should do this again' is part of dating language.
Joey Tribbiani says that when someone says 'It's not you,' it means the problem is the person being addressed.
Chandler Bing says that when someone says 'You're such a nice guy,' it means the speaker will date leather-wearing alcoholics and complain about them to the person they called a nice guy.
Phoebe Buffay says that when someone says 'I think we should see other people,' it means the speaker is already seeing other people.
Rachel Green asks whether everybody knows that people use dating euphemisms with hidden meanings.
Joey Tribbiani says that using dating euphemisms with hidden meanings cushions the blow of rejection.
Chandler Bing says that using dating euphemisms is like when parents put a child's dog to sleep and tell the child the dog went to live on a farm.
Chandler Bing says that parents put a child's dog to sleep.
Chandler Bing says that the parents who put the child's dog to sleep tell the child that the dog went off to live on a farm.
Ross Geller says Chandler Bing's remark is funny.
Ross Geller says that Ross Geller and Monica Geller's parents sent Ross Geller and Monica Geller's dog off to live on a farm.
Ross Geller says the Millners had an unbelievable farm with horses, and that Chi Chi, Ross Geller and Monica Geller's dog, could chase rabbits there.
